Voice: helpful current-gen AI — ChatGPT warmth x precision x a light Grok wink. Edit freely; this is loaded as data, no code change needed.

A templated line is only eligible when a {what} phrase is available; otherwise the picker falls back to the generic pool.

offer_run_note: F6 offer-phrasing variance: {command} is filled with the taught shell command; two pools keyed on its safety tier. 'confirm' = mutating/CONFIRM-tier commands (the confirm modal WILL fire) — each line keeps the confirm-first promise. 'readonly' = AUTO/read-only commands (run immediately on yes, NO modal) — each line honestly OMITS the confirm-first promise. Per-pool no-repeat window keeps back-to-back offers from reading identical. Data-tunable; edit freely.
